options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds.

options.name: api_token
options.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if O(profile) is not specified.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Scaleway API URL.

options.name: commercial_type
options.description: Commercial name of the compute node.

options.name: enable_ipv6
options.description: Enable public IPv6 connectivity on the instance.

options.name: image
options.description: Image identifier used to start the instance with.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the instance.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization identifier. Exactly one of O(project) and O(organization) must be specified.

options.name: profile
options.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of O(api_token). It is also possible to set E(SCW_PROFILE) to use a SCW CLI config profile.

options.name: project
options.description: Project identifier. Exactly one of O(project) and O(organization) must be specified.

options.name: public_ip
options.description: Manage public IP on a Scaleway server. Could be Scaleway IP address UUID. V(dynamic) Means that IP is destroyed at the same time the host is destroyed. V(absent) Means no public IP at all.

options.name: query_parameters
options.description: List of parameters passed to the query string.

options.name: region
options.description: Scaleway compute zone.

options.name: security_group
options.description: Security group unique identifier. If no value provided, the default security group or current security group is used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the instance.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to apply to the instance (5 max).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the instance to reach its desired state before returning.

options.name: wait_sleep_time
options.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the server.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the server to reach the expected state.
